The trajectory of 3D bioprinting has been remarkable. Humans have developed 3D printing technologies enabling artificial fabrication of human organs—this is established reality. We've progressed from printing simple tissues to complex structures like bladders, skin grafts, and cartilage.

South Korea has been at the forefront of biomedical innovation, with world-class research institutions and regulatory frameworks supporting cutting-edge transplantation.
